name: open
description: Open a single-web window: one tab showing `url`, a read-only address, back / forward / reload and the OS caption buttons. The window is pinned to the kSingleWeb UI mode, is never restored by session restore, and belongs to the connection that opened it: its events (onNavigated, onTitleChanged, onClosed) go to that connection only, and it is closed when that connection goes away. Only http, https and file URLs are accepted. Returns { windowId }.

inputs.name: url
inputs.description: The page to show: an http, https or file URL.

inputs.name: left
inputs.description: Screen x of the window's top-left corner, in DIPs.

inputs.name: top
inputs.description: Screen y of the window's top-left corner, in DIPs.

inputs.name: width
inputs.description: Window width in DIPs, at least 200.

inputs.name: height
inputs.description: Window height in DIPs, at least 150.

inputs.name: focus
inputs.description: Activate the window once shown. Absent: true.
